title: A BOOLEAN against an integer is cast to the integer
verdict: `b = i` casts the boolean to an integer; CASE and UNION of the two are INTEGER; sverify refuses them
description: `true = 1::INTEGER` is true; `CASE WHEN b THEN i ELSE b END` and `SELECT b UNION ALL SELECT i` are INTEGER columns.
reference: The lift refuses: `equal of boolean, int32`, `CASE of int32, boolean`, `UNION of boolean, int32`.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe observations (duckdb 2.0.0, Python, macOS arm64; session claude/duckdb-coercions, #1484 census)
provenance.notes: `python -m sverify_dev.probe --observations` records each query as it comes.

provenance.checked_by: session claude/duckdb-coercions (sverify.sql_lift.lift, semantics="duckdb", on origin/main b28e14ff)
provenance.notes: `lift` on `b = i32`, `i32 = true`, `CASE WHEN b THEN i32 ELSE b END`, `b UNION ALL i32`: each `SqlUnsupported`.
